title: cardboard texture pack
description: Turns jungle wood and netherite into cardboard, giving the game a simple, playful look.
body: This texture pack for Minecraft turns the whole game into a cardboard craft world. Jungle trees are replaced with stacked brown cardboard trunks and flat, cut-out green leaves that look like handmade paper pieces. Netherite is reimagined as dark grey cardboard with painted metallic highlights, giving it a “fake metal” toy-like look. Overall, everything feels like a DIY diorama made from paper and boxes, with a cozy, handmade aesthetic.
